explication: ox_inventory is a FiveM inventory NUI. The principal workflow is: FiveM sends initialization or refresh events, the React app stores inventory and item data, renders slot-based UI, then drag, context-menu, shop, crafting, and item actions post commands back through NUI. The sampled tree primarily covers the web client; server-side storage, validation, synchronization, and logging are documented capabilities but their implementation is outside this tree, so those relationships are shown only at the documented service boundary.
